title: Remove the cold task-sync custody audit, its full-snapshot read and their tests
outcome: Remove the cold task-sync custody audit, its full-snapshot read and their tests
acceptance: The `engram task-sync custody-audit` CLI command and its service entries (audit_task_sync_custody, audit_task_sync_incoming_data_commit, task_sync::exchange::audit_incoming_data_commit and _remaining) are removed, together with the cold full-snapshot reader they alone use (read_task_snapshot / read_with_limit / Reader::cold) and the custody-audit request and receipt types, wherever no other production code uses them; each removed symbol's production callers are listed on the item before removal

Ordinary task-sync export, import, the delta exchange and the one-command sync path keep their behaviour; the tests of those paths pass, and the tests of the removed audit are deleted with no replacement check, scanner or environment control

Custody or checkpoint records already stored in live stores keep being read as stored, with no store migration; if removing a type would stop an existing record from being read, that type is kept as a read-only historical decoder and the item says so
docs/shipped.md and the task-sync brief no longer describe the custody audit
disposal_reason: Engram::Fable, 02:10Z. Superseded by Greg's newest decision, via Asistant 43498a6e #1894 (02:08:01Z), verbatim: „przyspieszenie audytu to task P1 upewnic sie, ze nie jest uzywany w normych operacjach gdzie jeszcze jest problem ?”. Asistant: keep the custody audit and speed it up as P1; this replaces the earlier removal (#1886, #1893). No code was landed for this item. The speed-up is filed as a new P1 item.
